Maya Chen: Heads-up: I'm handing off coverage to Sam in ~2h. Quick checklist — can folks confirm VPN/pager/runbook access + any risky deploys today? I'll be available for 30m post-handoff for q's. TL;DR: need vpn, pager, prod-k8s creds, and access to the oncall runbook.
Samir Patel: @Maya Chen got it. VPN is fine for me, pager OK. I lost access to prod-k8s last week—I'll try now.
Maya Chen: @infra-bot please run an access-sanity check for Samir.
infra-bot: infra-bot: queued access-sanity for Samir. Result: missing `kube-admin` role in prod cluster. See https://ops.redwood/internal/requests/PR-432 for details.
Josh Lee: I can approve the role quickly. @Samir ping me when you're ready and I'll merge the IAM PR.
Samir Patel: Running `kubectl auth can-i get pods --namespace=prod` .. returns "no". Need the role.
Maya Chen: Pager check: Samir, confirm you can receive pages on PagerDuty (oncall schedule)? Also double-check phone DND.
Samir Patel: Pager tested: webhook and call route OK. DND was on, toggled off.
infra-bot: infra-bot: IAM PR merged by Josh Lee. Samir now has requested role. Note: propagation may take up to 2m.
Samir Patel: Re-tested: `kubectl get pods -n prod` — ✅ I can see pods now. I also have access to the runbook: https://wiki.redwood:8443/runbooks/oncall/prod-playbook
Maya Chen: Two quick FYIs before handoff: 1) Canary rollout for /generate started ~30m ago (low traffic), automatic fallback after 5m failures. 2) GPU spare quota in us-west-2 is low (~10% headroom). See #eng-infra for details.
Josh Lee: Noted on quota. Also pushed a tiny logging rotation patch — may create short burst of 502s on one backend for ~10m during rotation. Watch the error-rate dashboard, I'll post in #eng-runtime if it gets worse.
Samir Patel: Copy. If we see a surge I'll trigger fallback to cpu-instance pool per runbook section "fallbacks".
Maya Chen: Runbook quick verification commands (paste these during handoff):
```
# verify pager
pd list-incidents --service oncall --status triggered

# verify VPN / jumpbox
ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa jumpbox@jump.redwood.internal 'echo ok'

# verify kubernetes access
kubectl config use-context prod
kubectl get pods -n prod --short
```
Samir Patel: Ran the commands, all good now. One note: SSO prompted re-login earlier for the internal wiki; cleared cookies and helped.
Maya Chen: Good. I'll hand off at 16:00 UTC. Samir is primary; Josh is secondary. @oncall-bot please note handoff at 16:00 UTC.
oncall-bot: oncall-bot: Handoff recorded. Primary: Samir Patel. Secondary: Josh Lee. Handoff scheduled at 16:00 UTC. Escalation policy: ops-escalation after 10m.
Samir Patel: Got it — I'll be on-call. Thanks Maya.
Josh Lee: :thumbsup:
